'If you have a YELLOW card in your pitch zone, this gets +2{p}.'

The pitch ZONE, not the cards pitched to play this card: the zone holds everything pitched this turn, which is what the text asks about. A continuous property re-evaluated on every attack-power recalculation, so pitching a yellow card mid-combat turns it on. SOURCE_IS_ATTACK confines it to this card's own attack.
